newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Nov industrial output seen 13.2 pct up.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Nov industrial output seen 13.2 pct up.

text.p: Argentina's industrial production in November was 13.2 percent higher than in November 1995 but 1.9 percent lower than in October, the FIEL consultancy said Wednesday.
It said preliminary figures showed output rose 4.7 percent in the January-November period.
FIEL said it will revise its estimates December 23.

Separately, according to a survey carried out by FIEL, eight percent of firms considered demand to be on an encouraging track in November, 82 percent considered it to be at normal levels and 10 percent saw it as disappointing.
Within the manufacturing sector, 13 percent of firms polled said their stock levels were high in November, 80 percent responded that stock levels were normal and seven percent said they were low.
As for prices, 95 percent of firms expected no changes, four percent anticipate price declines and only two percent expect price rises.
